integrity: The argument transfers semantics only after reconstructing the modal induction step and uses the recent source solely for its all-functions partition-invariance and published validity classification. The finite enumeration is a sanity check, not a proof, and no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the pure equality language on infinite sets and to subcategories containing every finite equality-pattern collapse. It does not cover finite worlds, enriched structures, or uniformly bounded k-to-one classes for a fixed finite k.
title: Finite-collapse saturation of the equality-modal theory of infinite sets
